    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))
    if b_idx.shape[0] > max_pairs:

        # topk largest negative diffs means smallest diff_vals

        b_idx = b_idx[topk_indices]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_indices]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_indices]
    b_idx = b_idx.to(torch.int64)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.to(torch.int64)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.to(torch.int64)
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_thresholded_lower_is_better_004'}

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    # mask out the anchor to exclude it
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k), positive if topk worse than anchor

    # Only keep pairs where gap > 0 (anchor better)
    valid_mask = gap > 0
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Weight proportional to gap but capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_002'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n_items = objective.shape
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, ranks, torch.arange(n_items, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1))
    rank_i = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # shape (B, N, 1)
    rank_j = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B, 1, N)
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 3))
    band_mask = (rank_j > rank_i) & ((rank_j - rank_i) <= band_width)
    better_mask = (objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :])
    mask = band_mask & better_mask
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    weight = gap
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_pairs'})

g_ir.name: pairwise_lower_objective_pref_filtered
g_ir.intuition: Construct pairwise preferences where the item with lower objective value is preferred, ensuring at least one pair per batch by selecting top pairs with largest positive objective differences and including all such pairs.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # shape (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape

    # Compute pairwise difference: positive means i worse than j
    diff = objective.unsqueeze(2) - objective.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B,K,K)

    # Indices for pairs
    idx_i = torch.arange(K, device=objective.device).view(1, K, 1)
    idx_j = torch.arange(K, device=objective.device).view(1, 1, K)

    # Valid pairs: i < j to avoid duplicates and self-pairs
    valid_pairs = (idx_i < idx_j)  # shape (1,K,K)

    # Select pairs where i is worse than j (objective[i] > objective[j])
    pair_mask = (diff > 0) & valid_pairs  # shape (B,K,K)

    # If no pairs exist in a batch, we will add the single top pair with largest positive diff
    # Flatten pairs per batch
    flattened_diff = diff.where(pair_mask, torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=diff.device)).view(B, -1)  # shape (B, K*K)

    # For each batch, get top 1 pair index and value
    top_vals, top_idx = torch.topk(flattened_diff, 1, dim=1)

    # Prepare mask for pairs to keep: all pairs where pair_mask==True
    # plus top pair if batch has no pairs
    # We will build a mask of shape (B,K,K) for all pairs

    # Flattened pair_mask for indexing
    flat_pair_mask = pair_mask.view(B, -1)  # shape (B, K*K)

    # Identify batches with no valid pairs
    no_pairs_mask = (top_vals[:,0] == float('-inf'))  # shape (B,)

    # Start with all pairs that satisfy pair_mask
    final_mask = flat_pair_mask.clone()  # shape (B, K*K)

    if no_pairs_mask.any():
        # For batches with no pairs, add the top pair (even if diff <= 0) to ensure non-empty
        # top_idx is still valid (torch.topk returns something even if all -inf)
        # But top_vals are -inf, so we pick top_idx anyway
        # Set final_mask[b, top_idx[b]] = True for those batches
        final_mask[no_pairs_mask, top_idx[no_pairs_mask,0]] = True

    # Now decode final_mask indices to (b,i,j)
    b_idx, flat_idx = torch.nonzero(final_mask, as_tuple=True)  # variable length

    i_idx = flat_idx // K
    j_idx = flat_idx % K

    # Winners are j (lower objective), losers are i (higher objective)
    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(b_idx, j_idx, i_idx), weight=None, meta={})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    max_pairs = extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8192)
    
    # Compute pairwise preference mask: True where i preferred to j (lower objective better)
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, K, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, K)
    mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, K, K)

    # Flatten pairwise mask for each batch
    mask_flat = mask.view(B, K * K)  # (B, K*K)

    # To select only valid pairs, assign large score to True entries
    large_val = 10**6
    scores = mask_flat.to(torch.int32) * large_val  # (B, K*K)

    # Ensure max_pairs does not exceed K*K
    max_pairs = max_pairs if max_pairs > 0 else K * K
    max_pairs = min(max_pairs, K * K)

    # Select top max_pairs true pairs per batch
    topk_vals, topk_idxs = torch.topk(scores, max_pairs, dim=1)

    # Create mask to keep only true pairs (topk_vals == large_val)
    valid_mask = topk_vals == large_val  # (B, max_pairs)

    # Filter indices and batch indices by valid_mask
    filtered_idxs = topk_idxs[valid_mask]  # (N,)
    batch_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, max_pairs)
    filtered_batch_idx = batch_idx[valid_mask]  # (N,)

    # Decode flattened indices back to i,j pairs
    i_idx = filtered_idxs // K
    j_idx = filtered_idxs % K

    # pair_idx must be a tuple (batch_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx) with winner_idx preferred (lower objective)
    pair_idx = (filtered_batch_idx.to(torch.int64), i_idx.to(torch.int64), j_idx.to(torch.int64))  # tuple of 1D tensors
    weight = torch.ones_like(filtered_batch_idx, dtype=torch.float32, device=objective.device)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=weight,
        meta={'pairs': pair_idx[0].shape[0]}
    )

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # ranks: lower is better

    band_width = 5  # consider pairs where rank difference <= band_width

    # Expand dims for pairwise rank difference
    rank_diff = ranks[:, :, None] - ranks[:, None, :]  # shape (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = rank_diff.abs()

    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # b, winner_idx, loser_idx
    mask = (abs_diff <= band_width) & (gap > 0)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # no pairs found, return empty
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_gap_002'})

    gaps = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    # Select top max_pairs by gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk = torch.topk(gaps, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk]
        gaps = gaps[topk]

    # Weight proportional to gap, normalized to [0,1]
    weights = gaps / (gaps.max() + 1e-8)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_gap_002'})

g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by selecting pairs where the first index has strictly lower objective than the second, vectorizing over batches and pairs, and capping the number of pairs using topk without loops. Returns PrefBatch with correct tuple format for pair_idx as (batch_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx).
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    max_pairs = extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8192)
    
    # Compute pairwise preference mask: True where i preferred to j (lower objective better)
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, K, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, K)
    mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, K, K)

    # Flatten pairwise mask for each batch
    mask_flat = mask.view(B, K * K)  # (B, K*K)

    # To select only valid pairs, assign large score to True entries
    large_val = 10**6
    scores = mask_flat.to(torch.int32) * large_val  # (B, K*K)

    # Ensure max_pairs does not exceed K*K
    max_pairs = max_pairs if max_pairs > 0 else K * K
    max_pairs = min(max_pairs, K * K)

    # Select top max_pairs true pairs per batch
    topk_vals, topk_idxs = torch.topk(scores, max_pairs, dim=1)

    # Create mask to keep only true pairs (topk_vals == large_val)
    valid_mask = topk_vals == large_val  # (B, max_pairs)

    # Filter indices and batch indices by valid_mask
    filtered_idxs = topk_idxs[valid_mask]  # (N,)
    batch_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, max_pairs)
    filtered_batch_idx = batch_idx[valid_mask]  # (N,)

    # Decode flattened indices back to i,j pairs
    i_idx = filtered_idxs // K
    j_idx = filtered_idxs % K

    # pair_idx must be a tuple (batch_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx) with winner_idx preferred (lower objective)
    pair_idx = (filtered_batch_idx.to(torch.int64), i_idx.to(torch.int64), j_idx.to(torch.int64))  # tuple of 1D tensors
    weight = torch.ones_like(filtered_batch_idx, dtype=torch.float32, device=objective.device)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=weight,
        meta={'pairs': pair_idx[0].shape[0]}
    )

g_ir.name: builder_disagreement_sparse_neigh
g_ir.intuition: Sparse neighborhood pairs chosen via disagreement between objective and log_prob ranks, weighting by normalized disagreement magnitude
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks from objective and log_prob
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    obj_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(obj_ranks)
    obj_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, obj_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    lp_ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)  # higher log_prob better
    lp_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(lp_ranks)
    lp_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, lp_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    # Compute disagreement matrix (absolute rank difference)
    rank_diff = (obj_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2) - lp_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # For each item i, select top k neighbors j with highest disagreement
    k = min(extra.get('neighbor_bandwidth', 4), N - 1)
    # Mask out self pairs
    mask = ~torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    rank_diff_masked = rank_diff.clone()
    rank_diff_masked[~mask] = -1  # exclude self pairs from topk

    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_diff_masked, k=k, dim=2)  # (B, N, k)

    # For each (i,j) in topk, determine if objective_i < objective_j to define winner i
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_j = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, N, k)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # indices where i is winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos]

    # Compute disagreement magnitude weights normalized by max disagreement per batch
    disagreement_vals = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    max_disagreement = disagreement_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)  # avoid div0
    weights = (disagreement_vals / max_disagreement).clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.15))  # threshold for gap significance
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))  # cap on number of pairs

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    # mask out the anchor to exclude it
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k)

    # Only keep pairs where gap > threshold (anchor better but with meaningful gap)
    valid_mask = gap > thr
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Cap the number of pairs to max_pairs
    total_pairs = valid_mask.sum().item()
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        # Retrieve scores for valid pairs to select top ones by gap
        gap_scores = gap[b_idx, pos_idx]
        topk_scores, topk_mask = torch.topk(gap_scores, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_mask]
        pos_idx = pos_idx[topk_mask]
        winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]
        loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Compute weights proportional to gap, normalized, capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_003'})

g_ir.intuition: pairs chosen from sparse disagreement neighborhoods emphasizing uncertain relative preferences weighted by normalized log-prob difference
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(extra.get('neighborhood_size', 5), N - 1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute disagreement scores from log_prob differences
    # For each item, find top-k most disagreeing neighbors based on abs(log_prob difference)
    diff_logprob = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = diff_logprob.abs()

    # Mask diagonal to exclude self-pairs
    diag_mask = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
    abs_diff.masked_fill_(diag_mask, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select top-k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(abs_diff, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Generate pairs: winner is item with lower objective, loser is the other
    # For each batch and each item (anchor), pairs with their topk disagreement neighbors
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)  # (B, N, k)
    neighbor_idx = topk_idx  # (B, N, k)

    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_neighbor = objective.gather(1, neighbor_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_neighbor  # True where anchor better

    b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]
    loser_idx = neighbor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]

    # Compute weight as normalized log_prob gap capped at 1.0
    logp_winner = log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx]
    logp_loser = log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]
    gap = (logp_winner - logp_loser).clamp(min=0, max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_pairs_001'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n_items = objective.shape
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, ranks, torch.arange(n_items, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1))
    rank_i = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # shape (B, N, 1)
    rank_j = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B, 1, N)
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 3))
    band_mask = (rank_j > rank_i) & ((rank_j - rank_i) <= band_width)
    better_mask = (objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :])
    mask = band_mask & better_mask
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    weight = gap
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_pairs'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.15))  # tuned threshold
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))  # capped number of pairs
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (since lower is better, gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals)
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k)

    # Only keep pairs where gap > threshold
    valid_mask = gap > gap_threshold
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor as winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Cap weights proportional to gap at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    # Limit total pairs to max_pairs
    total_pairs = weights.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        # select top max_pairs by gap
        topk_gap_vals, topk_order = torch.topk(gap[b_idx, pos_idx], k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=True)
        selected_mask = torch.zeros_like(weights, dtype=torch.bool)
        selected_mask[topk_order] = True
        b_idx = b_idx[selected_mask]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[selected_mask]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[selected_mask]
        weights = weights[selected_mask]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_v2'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    # mask out the anchor to exclude it
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k), positive if topk worse than anchor

    # Only keep pairs where gap > 0 (anchor better)
    valid_mask = gap > 0
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Weight proportional to gap but capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_002'})

g_ir.intuition: pairs chosen from sparse disagreement neighborhoods emphasizing uncertain relative preferences weighted by normalized log-prob difference
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(extra.get('neighborhood_size', 5), N - 1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute disagreement scores from log_prob differences
    # For each item, find top-k most disagreeing neighbors based on abs(log_prob difference)
    diff_logprob = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = diff_logprob.abs()

    # Mask diagonal to exclude self-pairs
    diag_mask = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
    abs_diff.masked_fill_(diag_mask, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select top-k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(abs_diff, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Generate pairs: winner is item with lower objective, loser is the other
    # For each batch and each item (anchor), pairs with their topk disagreement neighbors
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)  # (B, N, k)
    neighbor_idx = topk_idx  # (B, N, k)

    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_neighbor = objective.gather(1, neighbor_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_neighbor  # True where anchor better

    b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]
    loser_idx = neighbor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]

    # Compute weight as normalized log_prob gap capped at 1.0
    logp_winner = log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx]
    logp_loser = log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]
    gap = (logp_winner - logp_loser).clamp(min=0, max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_pairs_001'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Generate all pairs with clamp constraint to limit pairwise differences
    diff_all = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask_all = diff_all < 0
    clamped_diff = diff_all.clamp(max=-0.5)
    b_idx_all, winner_idx_all, loser_idx_all = mask_all.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Generate filtered pairs based on a significant gap threshold
    gap = (objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None])
    mask_filter = gap > 0.05
    b_idx_filter, winner_idx_filter, loser_idx_filter = mask_filter.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Combine pairs
    combined_b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_all, b_idx_filter], dim=0)
    combined_winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_all, winner_idx_filter], dim=0)
    combined_loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_all, loser_idx_filter], dim=0)
    # Downsample if total pairs exceed max limit
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('pairing_budget', 128))
    total_pairs = combined_b_idx.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        scores = (objective[combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx] - objective[combined_b_idx, combined_loser_idx])
        topk_indices = torch.topk(scores, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        combined_b_idx = combined_b_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_winner_idx = combined_winner_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_loser_idx = combined_loser_idx[topk_indices]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx, combined_loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_pref_scaling'})

    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)

    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.15))  # threshold for gap significance
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))  # cap on number of pairs

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor

    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)

    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k)

    # Cap the number of pairs to max_pairs
    total_pairs = valid_mask.sum().item()
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        # Retrieve scores for valid pairs to select top ones by gap
        gap_scores = gap[b_idx, pos_idx]
        topk_scores, topk_mask = torch.topk(gap_scores, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)

        loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    # Compute ranks (0 is best)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # inverse rank map

    # Pair candidates: only neighbor items differing by at most 2 ranks
    rank_i = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    rank_j = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    neighbor_mask = (rank_j > rank_i) & ((rank_j - rank_i) <= 2)

    # Preference mask where i strictly better than j
    better_mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    combined_mask = neighbor_mask & better_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = combined_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute disagreement as negative absolute difference in objective (near ties preferred)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    # Weight: exponential decay emphasizing smaller gaps (more informative near ties)
    weight = torch.exp(-5.0 * gap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_disagreement_neighborhood'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # For each instance in batch, find the result with minimal objective (best)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,) indices of winner anchors

    # Gather winner scores
    winner_scores = objective[torch.arange(B), anchor_idx]  # (B,)

    # Compute gap: for each batch, gap between anchor winner and all others
    gap = objective - winner_scores.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N) (loser objective - winner objective)

    # Among candidates where gap > 0, find top gap loser per batch
    # Mask non-positive gaps
    mask = gap > 0
    # Set gaps <=0 to very large negative to exclude them in argmax
    masked_gap = gap.clone()
    masked_gap[~mask] = float('-inf')

    # Get index of loser with max gap per batch
    loser_idx = masked_gap.argmax(dim=1)  # (B,)

    # Filter batches where no valid loser found (gap max is -inf)
    valid_mask = mask[torch.arange(B), loser_idx]

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute normalized weight by gap
    gaps_vals = gap[b_idx, loser_idx]
    max_gap = gaps_vals.max().clamp(min=1e-6)
    weights = (gaps_vals / max_gap).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_winner_topgap_weighted'})

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, ranks, torch.arange(n_items, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1))

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)

    max_losers = int(extra.get('max_losers_per_anchor', 3))

    # We want pairs where anchor is winner (diff < 0)
    mask = diff < 0  # (B, N, N)

    # To get top gaps per anchor among losers, mask out non-losers with large negative fill
    masked_diff = diff.clone()
    masked_diff[~mask] = float('-inf')

    # Select top max_losers losers per anchor by largest negative difference (smallest diff values)
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_diff, k=max_losers, dim=2, largest=False, sorted=False)  # (B, N, max_losers)

    # Flatten indices where topk_vals != -inf (valid losers)
    valid_mask = topk_vals != float('-inf')

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).view(B,1,1).expand(B,N,max_losers)[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).view(1,N,1).expand(B,N,max_losers)[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = topk_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute absolute magnitude weights normalized per batch
    abs_diff_vals = (-topk_vals[valid_mask]).clamp(min=0.0)
    max_val = abs_diff_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (abs_diff_vals / max_val).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_topgap_weighted_magnitude', 'max_losers_per_anchor': max_losers})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(4, N-1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute prediction disagreement as absolute difference of log_prob
    # We'll find top-k most disagreement neighbors per item
    lp_i = log_prob.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    lp_j = log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    disagreement = (lp_i - lp_j).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask self pairs
    eye = torch.eye(N, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool).unsqueeze(0)  # (1, N, N)
    disagreement.masked_fill_(eye, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(disagreement, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Create indices for b, i, j
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2).expand(-1, N, k).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, -1, k).reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = topk_idx.reshape(-1)

    # Determine valid pairs where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
    valid_mask = obj_winner < obj_loser

    b_idx = b_idx[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute raw disagreement weights for valid pairs
    weights = (log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx] - log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()

    # Cap weights with threshold in extra or default 1.0
    cap = float(extra.get('cap_threshold', 1.0))
    weights = weights.clamp(max=cap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neighborhood'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    top_k = min(int(extra.get('top_k', 5)), N)
    band_width = min(int(extra.get('band_width', 10)), N - top_k)

    # Get ranks ascending (lower objective is better)
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)

    # Select top_k indices per batch
    top_indices = obj_ranks[:, :top_k]  # (B, top_k)
    # Select band indices immediately below top_k in rank
    band_indices = obj_ranks[:, top_k : top_k + band_width]  # (B, band_width)

    # Expand dims for pairing: top_k items as winners, band as losers
    # winner_idx shape (B, top_k, band_width)
    winner_idx = top_indices.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, top_k, band_width)
    loser_idx = band_indices.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, top_k, band_width)

    # Compute objective differences: winner_obj - loser_obj
    winner_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, top_k, band_width)
    loser_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, top_k, band_width)
    gap = winner_obj - loser_obj  # negative means winner better (lower)

    # Mask for pairs where winner strictly better (gap < 0)
    valid_mask = gap < 0

    b_idx, winner_pos, loser_pos = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_final = winner_idx[b_idx, winner_pos, loser_pos]
    loser_final = loser_idx[b_idx, winner_pos, loser_pos]

    valid_gaps = gap[b_idx, winner_pos, loser_pos]
    weights = (-valid_gaps).clamp(min=0)  # positive weights proportional to gap magnitude

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_final, loser_final), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'topgap_rankband_weighted'})

    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

g_ir.intuition: Sparse neighborhood pairs chosen via disagreement between objective and log_prob ranks, weighting by normalized disagreement magnitude
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks from objective and log_prob
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    obj_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(obj_ranks)
    obj_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, obj_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    lp_ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)  # higher log_prob better
    lp_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(lp_ranks)
    lp_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, lp_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    # Compute disagreement matrix (absolute rank difference)
    rank_diff = (obj_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2) - lp_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # For each item i, select top k neighbors j with highest disagreement
    k = min(extra.get('neighbor_bandwidth', 4), N - 1)
    # Mask out self pairs
    mask = ~torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    rank_diff_masked = rank_diff.clone()
    rank_diff_masked[~mask] = -1  # exclude self pairs from topk

    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_diff_masked, k=k, dim=2)  # (B, N, k)

    # For each (i,j) in topk, determine if objective_i < objective_j to define winner i
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_j = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, N, k)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # indices where i is winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos]

    # Compute disagreement magnitude weights normalized by max disagreement per batch
    disagreement_vals = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    max_disagreement = disagreement_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)  # avoid div0
    weights = (disagreement_vals / max_disagreement).clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks per batch
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # ranks: lower is better

    band_width = 5  # consider pairs where rank difference <= band_width
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # Expand dims for pairwise rank difference
    rank_diff = ranks[:, :, None] - ranks[:, None, :]  # shape (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = rank_diff.abs()

    # Create mask for rank band and objective difference > 0 (winner better than loser)
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # b, winner_idx, loser_idx
    mask = (abs_diff <= band_width) & (gap > 0)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # no pairs found, return empty
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_gap_002'})

    gaps = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    # Select top max_pairs by gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk = torch.topk(gaps, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk]
        gaps = gaps[topk]

    # Weight proportional to gap, normalized to [0,1]
    weights = gaps / (gaps.max() + 1e-8)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_gap_002'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(4, N-1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute prediction disagreement as absolute difference of log_prob
    # We'll find top-k most disagreement neighbors per item
    lp_i = log_prob.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    lp_j = log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    disagreement = (lp_i - lp_j).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask self pairs
    eye = torch.eye(N, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool).unsqueeze(0)  # (1, N, N)
    disagreement.masked_fill_(eye, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(disagreement, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Create indices for b, i, j
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2).expand(-1, N, k).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, -1, k).reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = topk_idx.reshape(-1)

    # Determine valid pairs where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
    valid_mask = obj_winner < obj_loser

    b_idx = b_idx[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute raw disagreement weights for valid pairs
    weights = (log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx] - log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()

    # Cap weights with threshold in extra or default 1.0
    cap = float(extra.get('cap_threshold', 1.0))
    weights = weights.clamp(max=cap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neighborhood'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(extra.get('neighborhood_size', 5), N - 1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute disagreement scores from log_prob differences
    # For each item, find top-k most disagreeing neighbors based on abs(log_prob difference)
    diff_logprob = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = diff_logprob.abs()

    # Mask diagonal to exclude self-pairs
    diag_mask = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
    abs_diff.masked_fill_(diag_mask, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select top-k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(abs_diff, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Generate pairs: winner is item with lower objective, loser is the other
    # For each batch and each item (anchor), pairs with their topk disagreement neighbors
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)  # (B, N, k)
    neighbor_idx = topk_idx  # (B, N, k)

    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_neighbor = objective.gather(1, neighbor_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_neighbor  # True where anchor better

    b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]
    loser_idx = neighbor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]

    # Compute weight as normalized log_prob gap capped at 1.0
    logp_winner = log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx]
    logp_loser = log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]
    gap = (logp_winner - logp_loser).clamp(min=0, max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_pairs_001'})

    gaps = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    margin = float(extra.get('margin_threshold', 0.1))

    # Compute ranks per batch (lower objective -> better rank)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N): indices sorted ascending
    # Invert ranks: create a tensor rank_pos with shape (B, N), rank_pos[b, idx] = rank of idx in batch b
    rank_pos = torch.empty_like(ranks)
    batch_arange = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, N)
    rank_pos[batch_arange, ranks] = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)

    # For each item, consider candidates within rank_pos+1 to rank_pos+band_width (band ahead)
    # Prepare pair indices indices
    band_end = torch.clamp(rank_pos + band_width, max=N-1)

    # We'll generate pairs (winner_idx, loser_idx) for winner rank < loser rank and objective difference margin
    # Extract pairs using mask and topk substitute: for each item find all items in band ahead

    # Use broadcasting to generate candidate loser_idx per winner
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    winner_ranks = rank_pos[b_idx, winner_idx]

    # Build masks for candidates in band: per (b,i,j), candidate j is in [winner_ranks[i]+1, winner_ranks[i]+band_width]
    # We invert rank_pos to rank_pos_inv where rank_pos_inv[b,j] = rank of j in batch b
    rank_pos_inv = rank_pos

    # We'll compare winner and loser ranks by checking if loser rank > winner rank and loser rank <= winner rank + band_width
    # Compare ranks for all pairs (broadcast)
    winner_ranks_exp = winner_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    rank_pos_exp = rank_pos.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    band_mask = (rank_pos_exp > winner_ranks_exp) & (rank_pos_exp <= winner_ranks_exp + band_width)  # (B, N, N)

    # Compute objective differences (winner - loser)
    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_l = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    diff = obj_w - obj_l  # (B, N, N)

    margin_mask = diff < -margin  # winner better than loser by margin

    valid_mask = band_mask & margin_mask

    b_idxs, winner_indices, loser_indices = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute weights as normalized margin gaps
    margin_gaps = (-diff[b_idxs, winner_indices, loser_indices]).clamp(min=0)
    max_gap = margin_gaps.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (margin_gaps / max_gap).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idxs, winner_indices, loser_indices), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_weighted_margin'})

    rank_j = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B, 1, N)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    weight = gap
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_pairs'})

g_ir.intuition: Sparse neighborhood pairs chosen via disagreement between objective and log_prob ranks, weighting by normalized disagreement magnitude
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks from objective and log_prob
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    obj_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(obj_ranks)
    obj_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, obj_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    lp_ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)  # higher log_prob better
    lp_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(lp_ranks)
    lp_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, lp_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    # Compute disagreement matrix (absolute rank difference)
    rank_diff = (obj_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2) - lp_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # For each item i, select top k neighbors j with highest disagreement
    k = min(extra.get('neighbor_bandwidth', 4), N - 1)
    # Mask out self pairs
    mask = ~torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    rank_diff_masked = rank_diff.clone()
    rank_diff_masked[~mask] = -1  # exclude self pairs from topk

    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_diff_masked, k=k, dim=2)  # (B, N, k)

    # For each (i,j) in topk, determine if objective_i < objective_j to define winner i
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_j = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, N, k)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # indices where i is winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos]

    # Compute disagreement magnitude weights normalized by max disagreement per batch
    disagreement_vals = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    max_disagreement = disagreement_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)  # avoid div0
    weights = (disagreement_vals / max_disagreement).clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh'})

g_ir.name: sparse_disagreement_anchor_pairs
g_ir.intuition: Forms pairs by anchoring on top objective scorers but only pairs with losers that disagree most on log_prob likelihood, capturing disagreement-driven sparse neighborhood pairing with weighted gap scaling.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']     # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    topk_disagree = 3

    # Anchor: best candidate per batch by lowest objective (winner anchor)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)

    # Gather anchor log prob and objective
    anchor_logp = log_prob[torch.arange(B), anchor_idx]  # (B,)
    anchor_obj = objective[torch.arange(B), anchor_idx]  # (B,)

    # Compute disagreement: abs difference in log_prob between anchor and all others
    disagreement = (log_prob - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)).abs()  # (B, N)

    # Exclude anchor self
    disagreement[torch.arange(B), anchor_idx] = -1.0

    # Select top disagreement losers per batch
    topk_vals, topk_idx = disagreement.topk(k=topk_disagree, dim=1)

    batch_indices = torch.arange(B).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, topk_disagree).reshape(-1)
    winner_indices = anchor_idx.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, topk_disagree).reshape(-1)
    loser_indices = topk_idx.reshape(-1)

    # Compute gap for selected pairs: loser_obj - winner_obj (positive gap means winner better)
    winner_obj_sel = anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, topk_disagree).reshape(-1)
    loser_obj_sel = objective[batch_indices, loser_indices]
    gap = loser_obj_sel - winner_obj_sel

    # Mask pairs with gap <= 0 (winner not better)
    valid_mask = gap > 0
    b_idx = batch_indices[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_indices[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_indices[valid_mask]
    gaps = gap[valid_mask]

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # no pairs found, return empty pair batch
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_anchor_pairs'})

    # Cap pairs by max_pairs by top gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk = gaps.topk(k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk]
        gaps = gaps[topk]

    # Weight: normalized gap scaled by disagreement (clamped)
    disagreement_vals = disagreement[b_idx, loser_idx]
    weights = gaps * disagreement_vals
    max_weight = weights.max().clamp(min=1e-8)
    weights = (weights / max_weight).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_anchor_pairs'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask = diff < 0
    bsz, n = objective.shape
    # Replace False with large positive for sorting
    large_val = 1e9
    diff_masked = diff.clone()
    diff_masked[~mask] = large_val
    # For each anchor (winner), select top 10% hardest losers (smallest difference)
    cap = max(1, n // 10)
    # diff_masked shape (bsz, n, n), sort losers per winner
    topk_vals, topk_idx = diff_masked.topk(k=cap, dim=2, largest=False, sorted=True)
    batch_idx = torch.arange(bsz, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(-1, n, cap)
    winner_idx = torch.arange(n, device=objective.device)[None, :, None].expand(bsz, -1, cap)
    loser_idx = topk_idx
    b_idx = batch_idx.reshape(-1)
    w_idx = winner_idx.reshape(-1)
    l_idx = loser_idx.reshape(-1)
    # Filter out pairs where diff_masked was large_val (invalid pairs)
    valid_mask = topk_vals.reshape(-1) < large_val
    b_idx = b_idx[valid_mask]
    w_idx = w_idx[valid_mask]
    l_idx = l_idx[valid_mask]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_percentile_cap_preference'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    # mask out the anchor to exclude it
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k), positive if topk worse than anchor

    # Only keep pairs where gap > 0 (anchor better)
    valid_mask = gap > 0
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Weight proportional to gap but capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_002'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Generate all pairs based on dense_all_pairs
    mask_all = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx_all, winner_idx_all, loser_idx_all = mask_all.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Generate sampled pairs based on gap
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    mask_sample = gap > 0.0
    b_idx_samp, winner_idx_samp, loser_idx_samp = mask_sample.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Combine pairs
    combined_b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_all, b_idx_samp], dim=0)
    combined_winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_all, winner_idx_samp], dim=0)
    combined_loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_all, loser_idx_samp], dim=0)
    # Downsample if exceeding max pairs
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    total_pairs = combined_b_idx.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        scores = gap[combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx, combined_loser_idx]
        topk_indices = torch.topk(scores, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        combined_b_idx = combined_b_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_winner_idx = combined_winner_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_loser_idx = combined_loser_idx[topk_indices]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx, combined_loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'hybrid_pairs_002'})

    clamped_diff = diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].clamp(max=-margin)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(extra.get('neighborhood_size', 5), N - 1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute disagreement scores from log_prob differences
    # For each item, find top-k most disagreeing neighbors based on abs(log_prob difference)
    diff_logprob = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    abs_diff = diff_logprob.abs()

    # Mask diagonal to exclude self-pairs
    diag_mask = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
    abs_diff.masked_fill_(diag_mask, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select top-k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(abs_diff, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Generate pairs: winner is item with lower objective, loser is the other
    # For each batch and each item (anchor), pairs with their topk disagreement neighbors
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)  # (B, N, k)
    neighbor_idx = topk_idx  # (B, N, k)

    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_neighbor = objective.gather(1, neighbor_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_neighbor  # True where anchor better

    b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]
    loser_idx = neighbor_idx[b_idx, anchor_i, neighbor_i]

    # Compute weight as normalized log_prob gap capped at 1.0
    logp_winner = log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx]
    logp_loser = log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]
    gap = (logp_winner - logp_loser).clamp(min=0, max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_pairs_001'})

g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks from objective and log_prob
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    obj_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(obj_ranks)
    obj_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, obj_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    lp_ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)  # higher log_prob better
    lp_inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(lp_ranks)
    lp_inv_ranks.scatter_(1, lp_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    # Compute disagreement matrix (absolute rank difference)
    rank_diff = (obj_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2) - lp_inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # For each item i, select top k neighbors j with highest disagreement
    k = min(extra.get('neighbor_bandwidth', 4), N - 1)
    # Mask out self pairs
    mask = ~torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    rank_diff_masked = rank_diff.clone()
    rank_diff_masked[~mask] = -1  # exclude self pairs from topk

    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_diff_masked, k=k, dim=2)  # (B, N, k)

    # For each (i,j) in topk, determine if objective_i < objective_j to define winner i
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, k)
    obj_j = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, k)

    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j  # (B, N, k)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # indices where i is winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_pos]

    # Compute disagreement magnitude weights normalized by max disagreement per batch
    disagreement_vals = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    max_disagreement = disagreement_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)  # avoid div0
    weights = (disagreement_vals / max_disagreement).clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask = diff < 0
    bsz, n = objective.shape
    # Replace False with large positive for sorting
    large_val = 1e9
    diff_masked = diff.clone()
    diff_masked[~mask] = large_val
    # For each anchor (winner), select top 10% hardest losers (smallest difference)
    cap = max(1, n // 10)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # (B, N, N)
    # mask for strictly better pairs
    mask = (diff < 0)
    # generate symmetric deduplication mask - only keep pairs where loser index > winner index to remove duplicates
    idx_i = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    idx_j = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    upper_tri_mask = idx_j[None, :] > idx_i[:, None]  # (N, N)
    mask = mask.logical_and(upper_tri_mask.unsqueeze(0))  # (B, N, N)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    raw_weights = (-diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    max_w = raw_weights.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = raw_weights / max_w
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0.05, max=0.95)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'objective_difference_with_dedup_and_clamp'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n_items = objective.shape
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, ranks, torch.arange(n_items, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1))
    rank_i = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # shape (B, N, 1)
    rank_j = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B, 1, N)
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 3))
    band_mask = (rank_j > rank_i) & ((rank_j - rank_i) <= band_width)
    better_mask = (objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :])
    mask = band_mask & better_mask
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    weight = gap
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_pairs'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device
    # Define sparse neighborhoods by cosine similarity of objectives - here approximate by k-NN in objective space
    # To simplify without external ops, use ranking proximity as sparse neighborhood: pairs within rank gap <= max_gap
    max_gap = int(extra.get('max_neighbor_gap', 5))
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # ascending ranks, shape (B, N)
    # Create inverse rank positions: position of each idx in sorted order
    inv_ranks = torch.empty_like(ranks)
    batch_indices = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, N)
    inv_ranks[batch_indices, ranks] = torch.arange(N, device=device)[None, :].expand(B, N)

    # Generate candidate pairs where rank difference <= max_gap
    idx_i = torch.arange(N, device=device).repeat(N, 1).T  # (N, N) rows i
    idx_j = torch.arange(N, device=device).repeat(N, 1)      # (N, N) cols j

    rank_diff = (inv_ranks[:, None, :] - inv_ranks[:, :, None]).abs()  # (B, N, N)
    neighbor_mask = (rank_diff <= max_gap) & (rank_diff > 0)  # exclude self pairs

    # Compute objective differences
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # (B, N, N)
    # Only keep pairs where difference < 0 (winner < loser)
    pref_mask = diff < 0

    combined_mask = neighbor_mask & pref_mask  # mask of pairs in neighborhood and correct orientation

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = combined_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Compute weight as absolute difference, normalized and capped globally
    abs_diff = (-diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    max_abs_diff = abs_diff.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (abs_diff / max_abs_diff).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neighborhood_weighted', 'max_neighbor_gap': max_gap})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    radius = min(3, N - 1)  # neighborhood radius

    # Create neighbor indices within radius for each item in N
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    idxs_exp = idxs.view(1, N, 1).expand(B, N, radius * 2)
    offsets = torch.arange(-radius, radius + 1, device=objective.device)
    offsets = offsets[offsets != 0]  # exclude self
    offsets_exp = offsets.view(1, 1, -1).expand(B, N, radius * 2)
    neighbor_idx = idxs_exp + offsets_exp

    # Clamp neighbor idx to valid range
    neighbor_idx = neighbor_idx.clamp(min=0, max=N - 1)

    # Gather objective values for items and their neighbors
    item_obj = objective.view(B, N, 1).expand(B, N, radius * 2)
    neighbor_obj = objective.gather(1, neighbor_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, radius * 2)

    # Pairs where item objective is better (lower) than neighbor
    mask = (item_obj < neighbor_obj)

    # Compute gap
    gap = neighbor_obj - item_obj  # positive gap since neighbor_obj > item_obj

    # Apply locality filter: only pairs with gap > 0.01
    locality_threshold = 0.01
    valid_mask = mask & (gap > locality_threshold)

    b_idx, winner_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_idx = neighbor_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, pos_idx]

    weights = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, pos_idx].clamp(min=0.05, max=0.7)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_neighbor_diff_clamped'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k)

    # Implement tie-zone filtering: only keep pairs where gap > 0.05 (explicit tolerance)
    tie_zone_threshold = 0.05
    valid_mask = gap > tie_zone_threshold

    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Weight proportional to gap but capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_tiezone_003'})

        # no pairs found, return empty

    gaps = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    # Select top max_pairs by gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:

g_ir.intuition: Anchor-based pairs formed by top-gap losers per anchor with normalized magnitude weights to focus on largest quality gaps.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_losers = int(extra.get('max_losers_per_anchor', 3))

    # For each anchor, find objective differences to all others
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # (B, N, N)
    # We want pairs where anchor is winner (diff < 0)
    mask = diff < 0  # (B, N, N)

    # To get top gaps per anchor among losers, mask out non-losers with large negative fill
    masked_diff = diff.clone()
    masked_diff[~mask] = float('-inf')

    # Select top max_losers losers per anchor by largest negative difference (smallest diff values)
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_diff, k=max_losers, dim=2, largest=False, sorted=False)  # (B, N, max_losers)

    # Flatten indices where topk_vals != -inf (valid losers)
    valid_mask = topk_vals != float('-inf')

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).view(B,1,1).expand(B,N,max_losers)[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).view(1,N,1).expand(B,N,max_losers)[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = topk_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute absolute magnitude weights normalized per batch
    abs_diff_vals = (-topk_vals[valid_mask]).clamp(min=0.0)
    max_val = abs_diff_vals.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (abs_diff_vals / max_val).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_topgap_weighted_magnitude', 'max_losers_per_anchor': max_losers})

g_ir.intuition: Adds explicit tie-zone filtering to exclude pairs with negligible objective gaps, ensuring clearer preference signals while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    # Basic pair masks
    mask_all = gap > 0
    b_idx_all, winner_idx_all, loser_idx_all = mask_all.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    mask_sample = gap > 0.0
    b_idx_samp, winner_idx_samp, loser_idx_samp = mask_sample.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Combine pairs
    combined_b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_all, b_idx_samp], dim=0)
    combined_winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_all, winner_idx_samp], dim=0)
    combined_loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_all, loser_idx_samp], dim=0)
    combined_gap = gap[combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx, combined_loser_idx]
    # Tie-zone filtering: remove pairs with gap < threshold
    tie_threshold = 1e-3
    tie_mask = combined_gap > tie_threshold
    combined_b_idx = combined_b_idx[tie_mask]
    combined_winner_idx = combined_winner_idx[tie_mask]
    combined_loser_idx = combined_loser_idx[tie_mask]
    # Cap pairs by top gap scores if exceeding max_pairs
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    total_pairs = combined_b_idx.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        topk_indices = torch.topk(combined_gap[tie_mask], k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        combined_b_idx = combined_b_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_winner_idx = combined_winner_idx[topk_indices]
        combined_loser_idx = combined_loser_idx[topk_indices]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(combined_b_idx, combined_winner_idx, combined_loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'hybrid_pairs_tiezone_003'})

g_ir.intuition: pairwise with fixed anchor vs top-ranked band to focus on rank-band geometry and capped weight
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(5, N-1)  # band size

    # For each batch, find the best item (lowest objective since lower_is_better)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)

    # Get top-k items excluding the anchor
    # mask out the anchor to exclude it
    mask = torch.ones_like(objective, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask.scatter_(1, anchor_idx, False)
    masked_objective = objective.clone()
    masked_objective[~mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_objective, k=k, largest=False, sorted=True)  # (B,k)

    # Compute gaps (loser - winner) since lower is better, winner is anchor
    anchor_vals = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # (B,1)
    gap = topk_vals - anchor_vals  # (B,k), positive if topk worse than anchor

    # Only keep pairs where gap > 0 (anchor better)
    valid_mask = gap > 0
    b_idx, pos_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx, 0]  # anchor winner
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, pos_idx]

    # Weight proportional to gap but capped at 1.0
    weights = gap[b_idx, pos_idx].clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_002'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    margin = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 300))
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask = diff < -margin
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    total_pairs = b_idx.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_indices = (diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].abs().topk(max_pairs))
        mask_top = torch.zeros_like(mask, dtype=torch.bool)
        mask_top[b_idx[topk_indices], winner_idx[topk_indices], loser_idx[topk_indices]] = True
        b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = b_idx[mask_top[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]], winner_idx[mask_top[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]], loser_idx[mask_top[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]]
    clamped_diff = diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].clamp(max=-margin)
    weights = (-clamped_diff).relu()
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_clamped_adjusted'})

g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    k = min(4, N-1)  # neighborhood size

    # Compute prediction disagreement as absolute difference of log_prob
    # We'll find top-k most disagreement neighbors per item
    lp_i = log_prob.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    lp_j = log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    disagreement = (lp_i - lp_j).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask self pairs
    eye = torch.eye(N, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool).unsqueeze(0)  # (1, N, N)
    disagreement.masked_fill_(eye, float('-inf'))

    # For each item, select k neighbors with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(disagreement, k=k, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, k)

    # Create indices for b, i, j
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2).expand(-1, N, k).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, -1, k).reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = topk_idx.reshape(-1)

    # Determine valid pairs where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
    valid_mask = obj_winner < obj_loser

    b_idx = b_idx[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute raw disagreement weights for valid pairs
    weights = (log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx] - log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()

    # Cap weights with threshold in extra or default 1.0
    cap = float(extra.get('cap_threshold', 1.0))
    weights = weights.clamp(max=cap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neighborhood'})

g_ir.name: anchor_winner_topgap_weighted
g_ir.intuition: Pairs each winner anchor with its top gap loser candidate, weighting pairs by normalized objective gap, and restricting geometry to anchor-to-top-gap loser only.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape

    # For each instance in batch, find the result with minimal objective (best)
    anchor_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,) indices of winner anchors

    # Gather winner scores
    winner_scores = objective[torch.arange(B), anchor_idx]  # (B,)

    # Compute gap: for each batch, gap between anchor winner and all others
    gap = objective - winner_scores.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N) (loser objective - winner objective)

    # Among candidates where gap > 0, find top gap loser per batch
    # Mask non-positive gaps
    mask = gap > 0
    # Set gaps <=0 to very large negative to exclude them in argmax
    masked_gap = gap.clone()
    masked_gap[~mask] = float('-inf')

    # Get index of loser with max gap per batch
    loser_idx = masked_gap.argmax(dim=1)  # (B,)

    # Filter batches where no valid loser found (gap max is -inf)
    valid_mask = mask[torch.arange(B), loser_idx]

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]

    # Compute normalized weight by gap
    gaps_vals = gap[b_idx, loser_idx]
    max_gap = gaps_vals.max().clamp(min=1e-6)
    weights = (gaps_vals / max_gap).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_winner_topgap_weighted'})

g_ir.intuition: Pairs formed by selecting each item's top-ranked neighbors within a local sparse neighborhood band, with uniform weights for simplicity.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_neighbors = int(extra.get('max_neighbors_per_item', 4))
    band_radius = int(extra.get('band_radius', 10))

    # For each instance, find indices within a symmetric band around each item
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    idxs_b = idxs.view(1, N, 1).expand(B, N, N)
    idxs_l = idxs.view(1, 1, N).expand(B, N, N)
    band_mask = (idxs_l >= (idxs_b - band_radius)) & (idxs_l <= (idxs_b + band_radius)) & (idxs_l != idxs_b)

    # Compute difference: winner = lower objective better
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # (B, N, N)
    valid_mask = (diff < 0) & band_mask  # only consider items in neighborhood band where winner better

    # For each item, select top max_neighbors losers by ranking diff (largest negative diff)
    diff_masked = diff.clone()
    diff_masked[~valid_mask] = float('inf')
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(diff_masked, k=max_neighbors, dim=2, largest=False, sorted=False)  # top losers per winner

    valid = topk_vals != float('inf')
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device).view(B,1,1).expand(B,N,max_neighbors)[valid]
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).view(1,N,1).expand(B,N,max_neighbors)[valid]
    loser_idx = topk_idx[valid]

    # Uniform weight for all pairs
    weights = torch.ones_like(winner_idx, dtype=objective.dtype)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'sparse_neighborhood_rankband_uniform', 'max_neighbors_per_item': max_neighbors, 'band_radius': band_radius})

g_ir.name: rank_band_anchor_weighted_gap
g_ir.intuition: Anchor-based pairing using a rank band neighborhood around anchor ranks with weights from normalized objective gaps.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    bandwidth = int(extra.get('rank_bandwidth', 5))

    # Compute ranks of items by objective ascending (lower better)
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B, N)
    # Invert ranks to get rank positions per item
    inv_ranks = torch.zeros_like(obj_ranks)
    inv_ranks.scatter_(1, obj_ranks, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1))  # (B, N)

    # For each item, define neighborhood as items within rank_bandwidth distance
    rank_pos = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    rank_pos_others = inv_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_diff = (rank_pos - rank_pos_others).abs()  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask pairs where rank difference exceeds bandwidth or self-pairs
    mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= bandwidth)

    # From candidate pairs, select those where winner has strictly better objective (smaller)
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    winner_mask = (obj_i < obj_j) & mask  # (B, N, N)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = winner_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute weights as normalized objective gap (loser - winner)
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    max_gap = gap.max().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (gap / max_gap).clamp(max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_anchor_weighted_gap', 'rank_bandwidth': bandwidth})
